visual_review.identity: Muted light tan compacted soil with sparse grouped embedded gray-brown angular stones and broad shallow diagonal scuffed/swept bands. Dry ground identity remains, without added puddles or explicit wheel tracks.
visual_review.style_review: Far fewer stones and much broader soil shapes than the original fine gravel carpet, but roughly fourteen stone groups and many more soil patch contours than the six-to-ten broad-plane target. Low-contrast residual grain and small edge scallops remain. Some stones have several faceted faces rather than only two.
visual_review.palette_caveat: Visually lighter and more golden tan than the original dusty gray-tan, though not vivid orange. Quantitative mean-color differences are saved.
